rows: Move the nightly checks off the pull request path
Pull requests finish in minutes instead of an hour, and the slow legs still run every night.
Pin the LibreOffice version used for interoperability checks
Results stay comparable from one run to the next, and a change of version is a reviewed change.
Bundle only fonts under open licenses
Every face OPF ships may be redistributed, embedded and installed without a separate agreement.

left.text: Numbers on the right, the reading of them here: the second half carried the year.
